description:
Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base; 10 signed-wallet free calls shared over rolling 30 days. Read the backend 402 body for x402 terms. Prepare a reference envelope and a digest binding the supplied source and destination, ready for the sender’s delivery step.
Operating boundary: Supply source, destination and artifact references. Read the prepared envelope and binding digest. The sending agent delivers it through its chosen transport; the human reviews the references and resulting acknowledgment.
POST /api/proof-relay. Existing product credentials, signed mandates, and single-use action grants remain required where applicable. This adapter grants no authority and never supplies server credentials. This current operation is a bounded computation on caller-supplied data.
name: wever_proof-relay
title: Proof Relay
